p1: Every morning, Ryan found a new photo on his phone. Of himself, asleep.
Taken at 3:12 a.m. Ryan lives alone.
His phone charges in the kitchen. And Ryan has never sleepwalked in his life.
Each night, the photos got closer. Last night... just his face.
So Ryan left his phone on the bench, filming the hallway.
At exactly 3:12, his bedroom door opened. Ryan walked out.
Eyes shut. Barefoot. He picked up the phone and carried it back to bed.
Then he opened the photo from that night.
But Ryan has never sleepwalked in his life. So who was in the hallway?
He played the video again. Right before it cut out...
The man opened his eyes. Looked into the camera. And smiled... with Ryan's face.
Ryan sleeps in his car now.
This morning, a new photo. Ryan, asleep at the wheel.
